_help: Wiki settings. featured: a Guardian name to pin on the home page (blank = a different one each day). hideFields: profile fields never shown on the wiki and stripped from the story doc by tools/update-story.ps1 (branches.json hiddenFields are always added). storyDocId: the Google Doc that tools/update-story.ps1 downloads. storyExcludeTabs: doc tabs left out of the wiki.
title: Luma Guardian Wiki
tagline: The encyclopedia of the Luma Guardians: every Guardian, branch, team and stronghold across Fire, Earth, Water and Air.
